answer: Require every agent to post a bond before trading, then split verification across a prism of independent auditors who each check a different facet: past task completion, stake age, and peer endorsements. All verdicts go to a public mirror log open to replay, so a sybil operator must fund and age many separate bonds while keeping every fake history consistent in the open. An umber flag marks identities whose endorsements cluster from the same few sources, freezing their bond until independent auditors clear them. One fake identity is cheap; a diverse, aged, publicly consistent set is not.
